history.changes: A month is closed once: the close is the month and the book, and a second close of them is refused at the door as done already — a second close booked a second lock and, in a market's pack, a second settlement (the whole-tree review of 2026-10-21, D3).
Closing a month is a door: a person names the month and the books, and the close is the fact markets build on.

description: Periods: closing a month is a door — a person names the month and the books, and period.closed is the fact. What a market does with it (locks, settlements, files) is the market's rules (DIRECTION 2026-10-15, "Month end").

activities.name: close_period
activities.description: Close a period: any day of the month being closed, and the book. A month is closed once in a book: a second close of it is refused as done already. A closed month refuses postings per event; a market's rules settle what the month owes (VAT, filings) on this fact.

rules.description: A closed period is a period_lock for its book: the month of the day named, the book named
